# Play Padel

> Play Padel is a booking platform that connects padel players and clubs in one place. Players browse clubs, see real-time court availability across different clubs, and reserve a court in minutes. Club owners get a full dashboard to manage courts, availability, closures, and reservations, with secure online payments (Mercado Pago) and a complete audit trail of every change.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](/): product overview, how it works, and getting started
- [Log In](/login): sign in to an existing account
- [Sign Up](/signup): create a new player or club account

## Notes for crawlers

Most of this application lives behind authentication (`/dashboard/*` and the onboarding flow) and is not publicly crawlable content — it is private, per-user application state (bookings, court management, player profiles, club settings), not indexable documents. The pages listed above are the entire public surface of the site.
